title: Binance Spot API to Increase Request Weight (2025-03-10)
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance Spot API will update the request weight of the following Rest and WebSocket (WS) API endpoints at  2025-03-10 12:00 (UTC) . Rest API WebSocket (WS) API Current New  Request Weight Request Weight api/v3/aggTrades trades.aggregate 2 4 Users may use the  "<symbol>@aggTrade" WebSocket Stream  to receive a real-time data push for aggregated trades instead of polling the Rest or WS APIs. Please input  lowercase characters  only for the <symbol> in this WebSocket Stream (e.g., “btcusdt@aggTrade”). Notes: Trading will  not  be impacted by the update.  There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. For More Information:  Binance Spot API Change Log Binance Spot GitHub API Docs  Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2025-03-05 Note:  This announcement was updated on 2025-03-05 to change the Github API docs link.
